scope_note: Source-dated independent auditor statements reproduced from original publicly hosted documents; Katoptron did not independently audit agency systems or confirm current settings.

reports.report_title: Independent audit of Shakopee Police Department ALPR system
reports.author: Lynn Lembcke Consulting

findings.statement: The report says Shakopee implemented Flock ALPRs in June 2025 and describes six permanent Flock ALPR locations during its audit. It does not establish how many cameras operate today.
The auditor reported a 30-day retention setting for Flock ALPR data and a 60-day setting for Axon squad ALPR data during the audited period. This does not establish current settings.
The report describes role-restricted access and audit trails, and says officers were required to record reasons and case numbers when accessing ALPR data during the audit.
The auditor recorded no discrepancies noted in the examined statutory categories. This describes the auditor's findings for the audited period, not an independent Katoptron compliance certification.

cross_period.transition_note: The 2026 auditor says Elsag use ended January 8, 2025; Axon squad readers began in January 2025 and Flock stationary readers began in June 2025.

reports.report_title: Stillwater Police Department 2026 ALPR Audit (Flock System) Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)

findings.statement: The independent auditor reported 17 stationary Flock ALPR units at the time of its September 2026 audit. This is an auditor-attributed historical count, not a current installation inventory or individual camera map.

The auditor reported a manufacturer-default 30-day Flock data retention period and said the Flock Vehicle Reads report confirmed it during the audit. This does not establish subsequent agency settings.

The auditor reported that Stillwater's Flock console showed no out-of-state sharing in its Shared Network section at the time of the audit. That is a time-limited observation of one interface, not proof no external agency ever accessed data.

reports.report_title: Hennepin County Sheriff's Office 2025 ALPR Audit (Flock System) Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)

findings.statement: The independent auditor reported four active stationary Flock ALPR units within Hennepin County in its October 2025 report. The count is historical, not a present-day equipment inventory.
The auditor reported a default Flock 30-day data retention period, confirmed by a Flock Vehicle Reads report reviewed during the audit period. This does not establish current agency settings.
The auditor described interagency ALPR data requests as reviewed through agency command. The report does not identify all current recipients or establish an ongoing shared-network permission list.

reports.report_title: Woodbury Public Safety Department 2023 ALPR Audit Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)

findings.statement: The independent 2024 summary describes Woodbury's Flock ALPR system for January 2022–December 2023 and reports 15 active stationary ALPR units and no mobile units at audit time. This does not establish current equipment or geographic locations.

The auditor describes interagency requests documented by agency, requesting party and case number during the 2023 review. This does not identify standing permissions or current recipient relationships.

reports.report_title: Independent Audit of Shakopee Police Department ALPR System (2024)
reports.author: Lynn Lembcke Consulting

findings.statement: The 2024 independent audit describes Elsag Plate Hunter ALPRs in three patrol vehicles, no stationary or fixed readers, and local Elsag EOC storage. This is an historical description, not a current camera count.

The 2024 auditor reported that Elsag EOC automatically destroyed ALPR data after 60 days and found no older data in its reviewed queries. The 2026 report discusses different Flock and Axon systems; those settings must not be compared as the same technology.

reports.report_title: Woodbury Public Safety Department 2021 ALPR Audit Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)

findings.statement: The independent auditor described up to two squad cars using ALPR systems between December 2019 and June 2021 and no stationary ALPR units during that period. The report describes BOSS administration but does not establish the hardware manufacturer; it is not evidence of historical Flock equipment.

The 2021 auditor reports that an earlier inspection of the BOSS backend found a configured 60-day retention period; its control panel was no longer accessible at audit time. This is historical configured retention, not evidence of current settings or Flock retention.

The 2021 auditor reports termination of Woodbury's mobile ALPR program in June 2021 and notification to the Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension. This does not establish the precise later start date of Woodbury's Flock stationary installation.

reports.report_title: Edina PD 2021 ALPR Audit Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)
reports.period_label: October 7, 2021 audit snapshot (period bounds not stated)

findings.statement: The October 2021 independent auditor reports Edina Police Department operating ALPR systems on nine squad cars and no stationary ALPR units at the time of the audit. The report names BOSS/PAGIS software but does not identify Flock hardware.

The October 2021 auditor reports checking the BOSS ALPR administrator panel to confirm devices were configured for no more than 60 days of data retention. This is not directly comparable to a later Flock default-retention report.

The auditor describes ALPR sharing requests being documented with agency name, requester and case number in the BOSS search audit trail. This establishes historical audit procedure, not current or standing Flock sharing partners.

reports.report_title: Independent Audit of Shakopee Police Department ALPR System (2022)
reports.author: Lynn Lembcke Consulting

findings.statement: The 2022 independent audit describes Elsag Plate Hunter ALPRs in three Shakopee patrol vehicles and no stationary or fixed-location readers between February 2020 and March 2022. It does not establish a contemporary device inventory.

The 2022 auditor describes Elsag EOC automatically deleting data 60 days after collection, with no older data found in sampled queries. This is a historical Elsag configuration, not Flock data retention.

The auditor reports no interagency ALPR data-sharing requests during the February 2020–March 2022 audit period. This is a finding about that historical period, not evidence of current sharing behavior.

The independent auditor reports that a May 2026 sample of interagency Flock sharing requests was documented by agency and justification and found justified in the sample. No named recipient list or current sharing policy is established.

reports.report_title: Wyoming Police Department 2026 ALPR Audit (Flock System) Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)

findings.statement: The independent auditor reported four stationary Flock ALPR units and no mobile Flock units in Wyoming during the August 2026 audit. This does not establish current operating conditions or individual equipment coordinates.
The August 2026 auditor reported a manufacturer-default 30-day Flock retention setting, corroborated by its audit-time Flock Vehicle Reads report. This finding is not proof of current settings.

The auditor reports three other agencies authorized to access Wyoming ALPR data under written sharing agreements at the audit date, with searches limited to 30 days and requiring an auditable justification. Their identities and current permissions are not established in this reviewed passage.
